data.narrative:
Galvanick is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Joshua Steinman, Brandon Park, and Feliks Pleszczynski, having raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression approach uses a $4.4B total raised proxy as a baseline, applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, implying an $11.0B valuation. The Peer-Median method examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—yielding a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The analysis produces a wide triangulated range of $340M to $12.6B, with a median point of $5.7B. The significant spread reflects material tension between methods: peer-based valuation anchors substantially lower than stage-progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the $4.4B raised proxy as a baseline and whether early-stage Defense & Security comparables adequately reflect Galvanick's specific technology, team, or market opportunity. Resolution requires deeper diligence on revenue trajectory, customer traction, and defensibility versus the peer set.
